title: Pullback homology comparison for the local replacement
statement: Given the hypotheses, structural output V ≤ U and P, and a quasi-isomorphism eP : P ⟶ (V → U)^*C, for every g and q the pullback homology of P is nonempty isomorphic to that of C pulled back to U.

proof.text: Apply pullback to the supplied quasi-isomorphism eP; bounded flatness preserves it and homology yields the displayed isomorphism.

pullback quasi-isomorphism homology finite free complex

lean.statement: theorem local_finiteFree_homology_comparison {T : Scheme.{u}} (U : T.Opens) (C Q : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ) (hCge : C.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hCle : C.IsStrictlyLE d) (hCflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 U.toScheme)) (hQle : Q.IsStrictlyLE d) (hQfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (Q.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) (e : Q ⟶ C) (he : QuasiIso e) (t : T) (V : T.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (P : CochainComplex V.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (hstruct : t ∈ V ∧ P.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE d ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))) (eP : P ⟶ ((Modules.pullback (T.homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C) (heP : QuasiIso eP) : ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ V.toScheme) (q : ℕ), Nonempty ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P).homology q ≅ (((Modules.pullback (g ≫ T.homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology q)
